top_choice_rationale: P001 (Crews, Deshaies, Handa) rests on a mechanism I can state in physical terms: a small molecule holds a target and an E3 ligase in proximity, ubiquitin transfer follows, and the proteasome removes the target. It was shown in vitro, in cells and structurally, and has been reproduced by many independent groups. The three names map onto the PROTAC concept (Crews, Deshaies) and the cereblon mechanism of thalidomide-type glues (Handa) without a fourth person, if the citation is worded at the level of E3 recruitment. Remaining risks are that no degrader is approved and that credit is crowded (Ciulli, Sakamoto). P002 is the more mature achievement but its attribution is unsettled among six names, so it ranks second. P003 is cleanly attributed but reads as an extension of the 2010 cross-coupling prize. No award is ranked last because several mature candidacies are scientifically sound.
